output.answer: Cisco's Chief Technology Officer is Tom Gillis, who holds the title of SVP and Chief Technology Officer. He drives Cisco's vision for systems-level platform innovation, spanning from the silicon layer through the software and systems layer. He previously served as SVP and General Manager of Cisco's Infrastructure & Security Group and led Cisco's Security Business Group, and before Cisco was SVP and GM of the Network and Advanced Security Business Group at VMware. (Note: Jeetu Patel is Cisco's President and Chief Product Officer — a separate role.)
caveats: Cisco also has regional CTO roles (e.g., EMEA CTO Chintan Patel, Cisco Canada CTO Cherif Gress) that are distinct from the companywide CTO; do not confuse them.

The exact date Tom Gillis assumed the CTO title was not independently confirmed in a dated news release in this research; the finding rests on Cisco's own executive bio and leadership pages as retrieved on 2026-11-11.

# Tom Gillis

SVP and Chief Technology Officer

Tom Gillis is the Chief Technology Officer at Cisco, where he drives the company’s vision for systems-level platform innovation. In this role, he focuses on helping customers navigate complex architectural shifts by leveraging Cisco’s comprehensive platform, spanning from the silicon layer through to the software and systems layer. A respected industry leader with deep expertise in secure integrated networking and enterprise computing, Tom is dedicated to empowering organizations to reduce risk, streamline management, and effectively adapt to the evolving technological landscape.

output.question: Who is Cisco's CTO?

key_facts.fact: Tom Gillis is Cisco's Chief Technology Officer, with the title SVP and Chief Technology Officer.
As CTO, Tom Gillis drives Cisco's vision for systems-level platform innovation, from the silicon layer through the software and systems layer.

Before becoming CTO, Gillis was SVP and GM of Cisco's Infrastructure & Security Group and led Cisco's Security Business Group; earlier he was SVP and GM of the Network and Advanced Security Business Group at VMware and co-founded Bracket Computing and IronPort Systems.

Cisco's official Executive Leadership page lists Tom Gillis among its leaders as 'SVP and Chief Technology Officer'; Jeetu Patel is listed separately as President and Chief Product Officer and Chuck Robbins as Chair and CEO.
